Questions

      
Before you call

      

        

          I locked my keys in my car. What do I do?
          
Call (215) 445-7156, say where the car is and the make and model, and stay with the vehicle. Peewee comes to you and opens it with professional lockout tools — no need to break a window or call a tow.

        

        

          I lost all my car keys. Can you still make one?
          
Yes — in most cases a new key and fob can be made and programmed from scratch for most makes and models, right where the car is. Call with your year, make, and model to confirm yours and get the price.

        

        

          My airbag light is on. Can you reset it?
          
Yes — we do airbag resets. We check the SRS / airbag system, reset it, and clear the light. Call with your year, make, and model so we can confirm your car and quote you on the phone.

        

        

          What does a full diagnostic cover?
          
A full diagnostic is a complete scan of your car's systems — check-engine and warning lights, airbag system, and more. We read the codes and explain in plain words what they mean before any work starts, so you decide what happens next.

        

        

          How much does it cost?
          
It depends on the job and the vehicle — and where you are in the city. Call (215) 445-7156 and you'll get your price on the phone before any work starts. No guessing, no surprises after the fact.

        

        

          Do you only work on cars?
          
Yes — cars only. Car lockouts, car keys & fobs, airbag reset, and full diagnostics for cars, trucks, and SUVs across Philadelphia. That's the whole focus, so the tools and equipment on the truck are all for cars.
